_comment: Deterministic routing rules for search V2. Rules are routing-only — they narrow the search space (category, tags, town) but do NOT pick which business ranks #1. Keep under 40 rules. Every new rule MUST have problemClass + a golden eval pair (regression tier). Every tag in requiredTags/anyTags must exist in search_tags_vocabulary. Validated by: npx tsx scripts/validate-tag-registry.ts

rules.description: Cart/LSV rental — 'golf' substring would otherwise match golf courses. Longest phrase wins over collision_golf_activity.
Golf courses/putting — must not surface cart rental businesses. Pair with collision_mobility_rental.
Bookstores — 'books' would bleed into general shopping. requiredTags prevents gift shops appearing.
Coffee shops — routes to coffee_shops category so restaurants/boutiques are excluded by category filter.
Remote work / business meeting queries route to coffee_shops — cafes are the natural answer, not offices or restaurants.
Bars and nightlife — routes to bars category so restaurants don't dominate. Prevents Red Bar ranking at #10 for live music queries.
Rainy day / indoor queries route to shopping — bookstores are the natural 30A answer for bad weather.
Massage/spa queries route to services — prevents fitness studios (Power Movement) polluting results.
